turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on he, she and it with -s?
turns.tutor:
Hello! Sure. In the present simple, we add -s to the verb after he, she and it: I work, she works. For verbs ending in -sh, -ch, -s, -x or -o, we add -es: he teaches.

Let's start: My sister ___ (play) tennis on Sundays. Write only the verb.
